title: Working from Home for the First Time
paragraphs: When his company shifted to remote work, Salim initially struggled to set up a functional home office, working from his bed for the first week before realizing this was affecting his productivity badly.
He invested in a proper desk and a decent chair, and more importantly, established clear boundaries with his family about when he was unavailable during focused work hours each day.

The video conferencing software also took some getting used to, since Salim occasionally forgot to mute himself during calls, once accidentally letting his family hear an entire conversation about lunch plans.

After a month of adjustments, Salim's remote setup finally felt professional and sustainable, and he told a colleague that the biggest challenge had never been the technology itself, but building proper habits around it.
